FIELD NOTE / SAN FRANCISCO

one lake, two names

01 / THE PROBLEM
A screenshot said Stow Lake. The map said Blue Heron Lake. The first run needed manual confirmation.
02 / THE CHANGE
I added historical aliases to the evidence and filtered out candidates that weren’t the right kind of place.
03 / THE RESULT
The resolver identified Blue Heron Lake on the rerun and showed the alias behind the match.

AMAZON / AUDIT TOOLING

150 → 45 hours

Approximate analysis time per cycle.

I built QueryQuencher for engineers investigating contract-processing audit trails. When audit responses grew past 10 MB, I switched to filtered, incremental retrieval so engineers could start with a summary and drill down as needed.

INTEL / MANUFACTURING AUTOMATION

760 hours a year

Estimated time savings for the workflow.

I built an internal chatbot that linked natural-language requests to manufacturing APIs, Python scripts, and a database. I documented edge cases and test scenarios for that workflow.
